intro: Each role has its own secure entry point. Field agents can sign up themselves; approvers and super admins use credentials provisioned by the program owner.

agent.title: Field Agent Portal
agent.subtitle: Sign Up or Sign In
agent.description: Register beneficiaries, submit intake forms, upload verification, and track your own cases.

approver.title: Approval Portal
approver.subtitle: Direct Login Only
approver.description: Review submitted applications and approve or reject cases with remarks.

superadmin.title: Super Admin Portal
superadmin.subtitle: Direct Login Only
superadmin.description: Full operational dashboard with analytics, agent monitoring, and recovery reports.
